čiṅgis: Čiṅgis — Chinggis, the title borne by Temüjin from 1206 [Ming gloss: 太祖名, 'the name of Taizu']
büri-bökö: Büri-Bökö — Büri-Bökö, a son's name (personal name; Ming 力士 'strongman', bökö 'wrestler, strongman') [(兒)名力士]
belgütei: Belgütei — Belgütei, a man's name (personal name; Ming (兒)名, a son) [(兒)名]
qojar-i: qojar — two; accusative -i, 'the two' as object (numeral + case; Ming 兩箇行) [兩箇行]
keġebe: keġe- — to say; past -be, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
žürkin-dür: Žürkin — the Jurkin, a Mongol clan (clan name) + dative-locative -dür, 'against, to the Jurkin'; also 'in, among the Jurkin' (name + case, front-vowel form) [種(名) 行]
büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
belgütei-ji: Belgütei — Belgütei, a man's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Belgütei (object)' (name + case) [(兒)名 行]
γari: γar — hand; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token left before the reflexive -(i)jan, 'one's own hand' (noun) [手 自的行]
jar: -jar — instrumental: with, by means of (case suffix; the token left after moṅgirsun(i)-; the Ming 敎 marks the means) [薤敎] · also in jabuγad(i)-jar, 'on foot' (Ming 步行着, the whole word; the token left after jabuγad(i)-, analysis uncertain) · also after arasun(i)- ('with the hide', Ming 皮子敎), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after Turqaγ̇ud(i)- (a mountain name; Ming 依着), 'along, by way of the Turqaqud'
barižu: bari- — to take hold of, grasp; converb -žu (verb, converb) [拿着]
jer: -jer — an ending of uncertain force, with the shape of the instrumental (the token left after sem(i)-; the Ming 噤聲的 glosses the whole word) [噤聲的] · also -jer after mör(i)-, 'along, by (the road)', instrumental (Ming 行) · also after tümed(i)-, 'with, by the tümens' (instrumental; Ming 萬(每)敎), and after ebür(i)-, 'along the front' (Ming (前)行)
ülü: ülü — not (negates present or converb forms) [不] · also before participles (ülü boluqui, ülü ögteküi), 'not'
ulus-un: ulus — realm, state, people; genitive -un, 'of the realm' (noun + case, back-vowel form after a consonant) [國(的)]
tende: tende — there, then (from tere 'that'; locative adverb) [那裏]
ögbe: ög- — to give; past -be, 'gave' (verb, past tense) [與了]
darun: dara- — to press down, suppress; converb -n, 'pressing down' (verb, converb) [壓]
jadan: jada- — to be unable; converb -n, 'being unable' (verb, converb; Ming 不得) [不得]
γarču: γar- — to go out; converb -ču, 'going out' (verb, converb) [出着]
kižü: ki- — to do, make; converb -žü, 'making' (verb, converb) [做着]
ni: -(n)i — accusative, marks the object (e.g. ökin-(n)i 'the girl' as object); the Ming writes 行 (case suffix) [女 行] · also on names and on müren (Temüžin-(n)i, De-Sečen-(n)i, müren-(n)i), where the (n) is Shiratori's; in places topic-like, 'as for Temüjin' (Ming 行 or (行))
odču: od- — to go; converb -ču, 'going' (verb, converb) [去着]
in-ü: in-ü — his, her, its (third-person genitive, placed after its noun) [他的]
qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇] · also before the thing counted: qojar sumu, 'two arrows' (Ming 兩隻 'two (arrows)')
tatažu: tata- — to pull, draw; converb -žu, 'pulling'; the Ming reads 做妾着 'making a concubine' for the sense here (verb, converb; no other source known here for tata- with this sense) [做妾着]
niruγ̇u: niruγ̇u — spine, backbone (Ming 脊梁) (noun) [脊梁]
quγulžü: quγul- — to break off; converb -žü, 'breaking' (verb, converb) [折着]
quγuražu: quγura- — to break off, snap (stem inferred; Ming 折); -žu converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [折着]
ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
bi: bi — I (first-person singular pronoun; the stems na-, nama-, min- before case endings) [我] · also 'is, exists' (verb, perhaps a short form of bü-, compare bijü; Ming 有)
nača: -(n)ača — ablative: from (back-vowel form; the token left after Burqan-Qaldun-(n)-, 'from Burqan Qaldun') [山名 自]
ajužu: aju- — to fear, be afraid; converb -žu, 'fearing' (verb, converb) [怕著︀]
bolun: bol- — to become, to be; converb -un, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming 做了) [做了] · also 'when, at the time' (Ming 時) · also in neġükü bolun, 'when setting off, on starting' (the participle neġükü + bolun; Ming 做呵 'when doing'; uncertain) · also bol- 'to become' with converb -un in the sense 'together, as one' (Ming 共)
jan: -(i)jan — reflexive-possessive, one's own (back-vowel form; the token left after γažar-tur(i)- and γažar(i)-) [地 自的行] · also after aqui-dur(i)- (a participle with dative-locative) · also after quruγ̇ud(i)-, 'one's own fingers' (a plural noun with the accusative i; Ming 指頭 自的行) · also after tergen-dur(i)- ('to one's own cart'), amin(i)- ('one's own life', accusative), γar-tur(i)- ('in one's own hand') and niγ̇ur-tur(i)- ('in one's own face'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after oin-dur(i)- ('in one's own mind') and morin(i)- ('one's own horse', accusative), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after aγ̇ur(i)- ('one's own breath, rage'), botoγan(i)- ('one's own camel foal') and turγaγ̇ud(i)- ('one's own companions'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also -(i)jan after kituγai-jar(i)- (instrumental, 'with one's own knife') · also after tuk(i)- ('one's own banner'), qurdun(i)- and dun(i)- ('one's own fast horse'), qujag(i)- ('one's own armour') and sumun(i)- ('one's own arrow'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after bolulčaγsan(i)- (a past participle with the accusative, 'what they had done together, their own'; Ming 共 做了的 自的行) and after jor(i)- ('his own sounding arrowhead'; the Ming 自的 has no 行), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after Uruγ̇ud(i)- and Moṅγud(i)- (people names; Ming 一種 自的行), 'one's own Uruqud, one's own Mongqud'
keġeġed: keġe- — to say; converb -ġed, 'having said' (verb, converb) [說了]
quγuru: quγu- — to break off, snap; -ru converb (uncertain; Ming 折斷) [折斷]
čirčü: čir- — to drag, to pull; converb -čü, 'dragging' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [拖着]
jorčiba: jorči- — to set out, go (Ming 去; stem inferred); past -ba, 'set out' (verb, past tense) [去了]
qabul: Qabul — Qabul, a man's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
qān-u: qān — ruler, sovereign, khan (title, the short form beside qaγan); genitive -u, 'of the Qan' (title + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝的]
köġüd-ün: köġün — son; plural -d + genitive -ün, 'of the sons' (noun + plural + case) [兒子的]
ökin-barqaγ: Ökin-Barqaγ — Ökin-Barqaq, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
bartan-baγ̇atur: Bartan-Baγ̇atur — Bartan-Ba'atur, Bartan the Brave, a son's name (baγ̇atur 'hero, brave man') [(兒)名 勇士]
köġün: köġün — son [子] · also read as a collective, 'sons', before a list of several names (Menen-Tudun-(n)u köġün … doloγ̇an, 'seven'; the plural köġüd is the usual form) · also 'lad, young man' (Ming 後生 'junior'), as in köġün küġün 'a young man'
jesügei-baγ̇atur: Jesügei-Baγ̇atur — Yesügei-Ba'atur, Yesügei the Brave, a son's name (baγ̇atur 'hero, brave man') [(兒)名 勇士]
teġün-ü: teġün-ü — of that, his, her (tere, stem teġün- before case endings, + genitive -ü, front-vowel form) [那的]
bartan-baγ̇atur-un: Bartan-Baγ̇atur — Bartan-Ba'atur, a man's name; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case) [(人)名的]
köġün-eče: köġün — son, lad, young man; ablative -eče, 'from the lad' (noun + ablative; the Ming writes 行) [幼小人行]
omoγtan: omoγ — pride, daring (noun; Ming 勇; stem uncertain) + possessive plural -tan, 'those having daring' (noun + possessive, plural, back-vowel form) [勇 有的(每)]
salžiγ̇ud: Salžiγ̇ud — the Saljiud, a clan (clan name, plural in -d) [一種(姓名)]
qamtudču: qamtud- — to be together, to join (from qamtu 'together'; stem inferred; Ming 相合); converb -ču, 'joining' (verb, converb) [相合着]
teriġüten: teriġü — head; plural possessive -ten, 'those having heads, the headed ones' (noun + plural possessive; uncertain: the Ming 項每 has 項 'neck' or 'item, kind' (perhaps 頭項 'headman'), so 'chiefs' and 'branches' are both only readings) [項每] · also with the Ming 等項 'and the like', 'X and the other headmen' (項 'item' or 'neck', 等 'and so on') · also with the Ming 等項 'and the rest', after a name: Žamuqa teriġüten, 'Jamuqa and those headed by him' (uncertain)
tatar: Tatar — the Tatar, a people (proper name) [(種名)]
nü: -(n)ü — genitive: of (front-vowel form) [的] · also printed after an n-final stem (Tumbinai-Sečen-(n)ü) and after back-vowel names (Qabul-Qaγan-(n)ü), where the front-vowel form breaks harmony; the Ming 訥 writes -nu and -nü alike
tatar-un: Tatar — the Tatars, a people; genitive -un, 'of the Tatars' (name + case; Ming (種名)的) [(種名)的]
ikires-ün: Ikires — the Ikires, a people; -ün: genitive: of (front-vowel form) [種名(的)]
merkid-ün: Merkid — the Merkid, a people; genitive -ün after a consonant (name + case) [種名(的)]
toγtoγ̇a-beki-jin: Toγtoγ̇a-Beki — Toqto'a Beki, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Toqto'a Beki' (one two-part name + case) [人名 的]
qutu: Qutu — Qutu, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
taičiγ̇ud-un: Taičiγ̇ud — the Taichi'ud, a clan; genitive -un, 'of the Taichi'ud' (name + case, back-vowel form after a consonant) [種名的]
taičiγ̇ud: Taičiγ̇ud — the Taichi'ud, a clan name, (proper name; the ending -d is probably the plural, which the Ming does not mark) [一種(名)]
edün: edün — these (plural of ene; Ming 這些每) (demonstrative pronoun) [這些每]
qarin: qarin — back, again (adverb; Ming 回) [囘] · also 'tribe, division' (Ming 部 'division, section'; sense uncertain), in harban γurban qarin, 'thirteen divisions'
čiγ̇ulžu: čiγul- — to gather, assemble; converb -žu, 'assembling' (verb, converb) [聚着]
žažiradai: Žažiradai — Jajiradai, a man's name (personal name) [兒名]
žamuqa-ji: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name (personal name); -ji accusative: marks the object (after a vowel) [人名行]
qā: qā — qaγan, sovereign (a contracted form of qaγan; plural qād) (noun, title) [皇帝]
keġen: keġe- — to say; keġen 'saying', the converb that closes a quotation (verb, converb) [麽道]
tendēče: tende — there; ablative -ēče, 'from there' (adverb + case; long vowel from tende + -eče) [那裏自]
huruγ̇u: huruγ̇u — downstream, following the course, along [順]
neġüžü: neġü- — to move camp, to migrate; converb, 'moving camp' [起着]
waṅ-qān: Waṅ-Qān — Wang Qan, ruler of the Kereid (personal name; Chinese wang 'prince' + qan) [人名]
qojar-tur: qojar — two; dative-locative -tur, 'in, among the two' (numeral + case; Ming 兩箇 + 裏) [兩箇 裏]
morilaja: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb: to ride; hortative -ja, 'let us mount' (noun-derived verb, hortative, first person plural) [上馬咱]
keġeldübe: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü- + past -be, 'said together, agreed' (verb, reciprocal past) [共說了]
külelkü-de: Külelkü — a place name (Ming 地名; compare Kürelkü, printed with r, perhaps the same); dative-locative -de, 'at' (place name + case, front-vowel form) [地名 行]
büküi-dür: bü- — to be; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the being, when being' (verb, participle + case; Ming 有時) [有時]
kürgežü: kürge- — to bring to, deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); converb -žü, 'delivering' (verb, converb) [送到着]
iležüġü: ile- — to send (as in ilebe, Ming 敎去了); past narrative -žüġü, 'sent' (verb, past narrative; uncertain: the Ming 去了有來 reads 'went', which would make the envoy the subject) [去了有來]
waṅ-qan-dur: Waṅ-Qan — Wang Qan, ruler of the Kereid (Chinese wang 'prince' + qan); dative-locative -dur, 'to, at' (title + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝 行]
ileġesü: ile- — to send (the Ming glosses 去 'go'); conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) sends' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form) [去呵]
kürġeġülüġed: kürge- — to bring to, deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); causative -ġül-, converb -üġed, 'having caused to arrive, having brought' (verb, causative converb) [敎到了]
eġüsčü: eġüsge- — to begin, set out, set going; converb -čü, 'setting out' (verb, converb, front-vowel form; printed eġüsčü) [起着]
qaγan-dur: qaγan — qan, sovereign, emperor; dative-locative -dur, 'to the qan' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝 行]
kürčü: kür- — to reach, arrive; converb -čü after r, 'arriving' (verb, converb) [到着]
irebe: ire- — to come; past -be, 'came' [來了] · also where the Ming has 去了 'went' (Boγ̇orču … urižu irebe, §95, 'came'; ire- means 'come', so the Ming 去了 is not translated)
žamuqa-jin: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of Jamuqa' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
esergü: esergü — facing, against, to meet (adverb; Ming 迎着) [迎着]
keġeldüžü: keġe- — to say; -ldü- 'together' + converb -žü, 'saying together' (verb, reciprocal converb) [共說着]
kelüren: Kelüren — the Kerülen, a river name [河名]
morilarun: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb: to ride; converb of time -run, 'when mounting' (noun-derived verb, converb, back-vowel form) [上馬時]
altan: altan — gold (noun); a man's name, as a son's name (Altan); and in Altan Qaγan the title of the Jin emperor, where the Ming glosses 金 'gold, Jin' (noun, personal name, title) [(兒)名; 金]
qučar: Qučar — Quchar, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
γurban-i: γurban — three; -i accusative or topic marker, 'the three, as for the three' (numeral + case) [三箇 行]
žaqaγambu: Žaqaγambu — Jaqa Gambu, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
ede: ede — these (plural of ene) (demonstrative pronoun) [這(的每)]
ilerün: ile- — to send (as in ilebe, Ming 敎去了); converb of time -rün, 'sending, when sending' (verb, converb; uncertain: here the Ming gives 去 'go', so 'going' is another possible reading) [去]
talbiba: talbi- — to let go, set loose, release; past -ba, 'let go' (verb, past tense) [放了]
bidan-u: bidan-u — of us, our (bida 'we, inclusive', stem bidan-, + genitive -u, back-vowel form) [咱的]
baγ̇uja: baγ̇u- — to come down, to descend; hortative -ja, 'let us come down' (verb, hortative, back-vowel form) [(下)咱] · baγ̇u- also 'to dismount, to camp', hortative -ja 'let us camp' (Ming 下) [下咱]
keġeldün: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü-, converb -n, 'saying to one another' (verb, converb) [相說]
qaγ̇ulžu: qaγ̇ul- — to rush, run; converb -žu, 'rushing' (verb, converb) [奔着]
irežü: ire- — to come; converb -žü, 'coming' (verb, converb) [來着]
aiši: ai- — to come (compare aisu-, aisun); ending -ši, 'am coming, is coming' (verb, present; analysis uncertain, resting on the Ming 有) [來有] · also (uncertain) an imperative, 'come!', read from the bare Ming 來; the ending -ši cannot be decided from the Ming
kürgen: kürge- — to bring to, to deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); converb -n, 'bringing' (verb, converb) [送到]
tere: tere — that, that one; also 'he, she' (demonstrative and third-person pronoun; plural tede) [那般]
ireġed: ire- — to come; converb -ġed, 'having come' (verb, converb, perfective) [來了]
baγ̇un: baγ̇u- — to dismount, to camp (Ming 下); -n: converb: -ing [下]
jabužu: jabu- — to go, travel; converb -žu, 'going' (verb, converb) [行着]
kürülčežü: kürülče- — to come together (from kür- 'reach'; stem inferred; Ming 相到); converb -žü, 'coming together' (verb, converb) [相到着]
abču: ab- — to take; converb -ču, 'taking' (verb, converb) [要着]
asaγasuγ̇asu: asaγa- — to ask; conditional converb -γ̇asu 'if/when'; the element -su- is unaccounted for, uncertain (verb, converb) [問呵]
unšižu: unši- — to call out; converb -žu, 'calling' (verb, converb) [叫着]
boldažu: bolda- — to be made, become (passive; stem uncertain, Ming 被黑做着 'be made dark'); converb -žu, 'being made …' (verb, passive converb) [被黑做着]
manaγar: manaγar — tomorrow, the next day (adverb) [明] · also 'next morning, early morning, this morning' (Ming 淸, 淸早 'clear, early')
γol-dur: γol — stream, ravine (Ming 澗 'mountain stream'); -dur: dative-locative: at, in (back-vowel form) [澗 行]
neilen: neile- — to join, to come together (Ming 相合); converb -n, 'joining' (verb, converb) [相合]
qonoba: qono- — to spend the night; past -ba, 'spent the night' (verb, past) [宿了]
baildužu: bai- — to stand; reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu, 'standing against one another, joining battle' (verb, reciprocal converb; Ming 對戰) [對戰着]
müd: müd — they (third-person plural; Ming 他每) (pronoun; the exact form is uncertain) [他每]
ažuγ̇ui: a- — to be, to remain (verb); past ending -žuγ̇ui, 'was, remained' (verb, past, back-vowel form; uncertain) [有來]
an-u: an-u — their (back-vowel companion of in-ü, third-person genitive placed after its noun) [他的]
bolžuγ̇u: bol- — to become, to be; past -žuγ̇u, 'has become' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [每做了]
jadažu: jada- — to be in want, to lack; converb -žu (verb, converb) [窮乏着] · also jada- 'to be unable', converb -žu, 'being unable' (Ming 不得着, 不能着), as in köġüd(i)-jen gelin jadažu, 'unable to drive off'
ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾] · before a converb: ese toγ̇aγdažu 'not yet counted' (as ese ögdegsen 'not given' in §6), where ülü is the usual negative of a converb
bida: bida — we, us (inclusive: you and I; first-person plural pronoun, Ming 咱) [咱]
